title: Franklin Baker Run for Coconut Farmers 2026 San Pablo Review
seo_title: Franklin Baker Run San Pablo 2026 Review | Laguna Philippines
meta_description: Franklin Baker Run for Coconut Farmers 2026 San Pablo: September 13 at Sampaloc Lake. A lakeside charity run for coconut communities.
dek: Set for 13 September 2026 at the Sampaloc Lake Boardwalk in San Pablo City, Laguna, this charity run supports coconut farming communities at one of the Seven Lakes.
verdict: The Franklin Baker Run for Coconut Farmers San Pablo leg brings the coconut-farming charity race to San Pablo City — Laguna's 'City of Seven Lakes.' Start at the Sampaloc Lake Boardwalk provides a scenic lakeside venue. The coconut-farmer advocacy gives the race purpose-driven character. September in Laguna is the tail of the wet season. For runners wanting a Laguna charity race with a scenic lake setting and social-impact credentials, this is a meaningful pick.

sections.heading: Lakeside for Coconut Farmers
paragraphs: Sampaloc Lake — one of San Pablo's Seven Lakes — provides a scenic boardwalk start/finish venue. [1] Franklin Baker's coconut-farmer charity mission gives the race genuine social-purpose character. The lakeside setting makes this the more scenic of the two Franklin Baker race legs.
